company.shortDescription: Enflux provides the most powerful decision support platform for higher education.
company.description: Enflux provides the most powerful decision support platform for higher education. We pull together all your siloed and static data—both internal and external—and curate them into insightful, actionable reports in real-time. With our solutions, your institution can significantly improve its overall performance and easily provide data-backed performance metrics to federal and accreditation agencies.

productsAndServices.description: A higher education data analytics and decision-support platform that unifies assessment, LMS, survey, academic, and clinical data for program evaluation, student success, curriculum oversight, and accreditation reporting.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered solution for Physician Assistant programs that supports ARC-PA C1.01 self-study reporting, PANCE readiness analysis, and continuous program improvement.

productsAndServices.description: A set of dashboards that centralizes ExamSoft assessment data for analyzing item effectiveness, curricular intent, student performance outcomes, and tagging fidelity.

productsAndServices.description: An off-the-shelf reporting tool that converts IPEDS data into visual comparisons of higher education institutions, academic programs, enrollment, completions, demographics, and related trends.

productsAndServices.description: A physical therapy education analytics suite for monitoring and benchmarking student and program performance related to the NPTE® and PEAT® examinations.
